title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $210 on Eufy Omni C20
excerpt: It can even be controlled by your smart home devices.
content_html:
SAVE $210: As of Aug. 24, the Eufy Omni C20 is on sale for $339.99 at Amazon. That's a 38% discount on the list price.

Credit: eufy

$339.99 at Amazon
$549.99 Save $210

Robot vacuum deals are always worth a look. Right now, you'll find lots of deals on great models at Amazon, but this offer on the Eufy Omni C20 is a standout option this week.

As of Aug. 24, the Eufy Omni C20 robot vacuum is at its lowest-ever price on Amazon, with $210 off the list price. This brings the cost down to $339.99. This Eufy model also has built-in mopping, so your floors are fully cared for.

This robot vacuum also comes with an Omni Station that automatically empties dust into a 3.1-liter bag for up to 60 days. In this dock, it will also keep on top of washing and drying the mop pads, so you don't have to. For picking up dirt, it uses up to 7,000Pa of suction, automatically adjusts with BoostIQ, and has a Pro-Detangle Comb that helps loosen hair from the roller brush.

For mopping, you'll get 6N of downward pressure applied at 180 RPM. Plus, the mops will automatically lift when it detects carpet.
